function.name: mcp__ida__get_metadata
function.description: Binary metadata: file name, platform (OS + binary format), architecture and bitness, image base, function count, stripped status.

function.name: mcp__ida__decompile_function
function.description: Decompile one function. Returns C-like pseudocode.

addr.description: Hex address (e.g. "0x1000") or a name in the binary (e.g. "sub_1000", "dword_1000")

force.description: Create the function at this address if IDA has none; use only after the same call without force failed (default false)

function.name: mcp__ida__disassemble_function
function.description: Disassemble one function, one instruction per line as "address: mnemonic operands". Known names (sub_1000, dword_1000, aText) replace raw operand values, and a referenced string's content is appended as ; "text". Long output is capped — pass offset to continue past a truncation.

addr.description: Hex address (e.g. "0x1000") or a name in the binary (e.g. "sub_1000", "dword_1000")

offset.description: Number of instructions to skip from the function start

force.description: Create the function at this address if IDA has none; use only after the same call without force failed (default false)

function.name: mcp__ida__get_xrefs_to
function.description: All cross-references to one function or global: every call, jump, data read, and data write that targets it, each with the referencing address and the function containing that reference.

addr.description: Hex address (e.g. "0x1000") or a name in the binary (e.g. "sub_1000", "dword_1000")

function.name: mcp__ida__get_xrefs_from
function.description: All cross-references from one function: every call, jump, and global it reads or writes, each with the instruction address and the target's address and name.

addr.description: Hex address (e.g. "0x1000") or a name in the binary (e.g. "sub_1000", "dword_1000")

function.name: mcp__ida__read_bytes
function.description: Read raw bytes at an address as a hexdump: 16 bytes per line, hex values plus an ASCII column ('.' for non-printable). The containing segment is named (.bss bytes read as zeros — it has no file contents).

addr.description: Hex address (e.g. "0x1000") or a name in the binary (e.g. "sub_1000", "dword_1000")

size.description: Number of bytes to read (1-512, default 64)

function.name: Write
function.description: Replace decompiled.c, then receive compiler diagnostics.

function.name: Edit
function.description: Replace one unique literal occurrence in decompiled.c; receive compiler diagnostics.
